reviews.title: Watch Out
reviews.text:
I purchased the NFL pass when I was in Europe for 2 weeks. I intentionally purchased a package that I thought was a monthly packages so that I could get one month of NFL football while I was there, and cancel it once I left Europe. I was basically paying $25 for one game that I wanted to watch while I was there, and I was ok with what I viewed as being a little bit of an overpayment.

After canceling I was charged for two additional months. The package apparently was not monthly, it was for the year but I was charged monthly. So I ended up paying $75 to watch a single NFL game while I was abroad. This was not clear at all when I purchased the subscription, or I never would have purchased it. I contacted customer service (who was very responsive to their credit) but who denied me a refund for the additional 2 months.

reviews.title: Zero brains
reviews.text:
Thanks DAZN, Truly Revolutionary…

Amazing job, DAZN. I paid for a sports streaming service and somehow still couldn’t watch Champions League matches live while flying. Stunning innovation — a platform designed for football fans that doesn’t actually show all the football when you want it.

It’s almost poetic… buying a streaming app so you can watch the one competition everyone cares about, only to be politely told, “Nah, not that match. Try something else.”

Really appreciate the suspense though — nothing beats refreshing Twitter at 35,000 feet to find out goals I should’ve been watching live.

Five stars for teaching me patience. Zero stars for broadcasting.
